en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small town nestled at the edge of a dense forest and rolling farmland. In the foreground are early 20th‑century houses and villas along a tree‑lined street; behind them rises a wooded hillside, with open fields visible on the crest. The caption at the top left in red print reads "Tharandt. Wilsdrufferstrasse," identifying the view as a street scene in Tharandt.
